about: Metal's turn direction (metal.md §6.7, the 2026-10-20 stress test): the cover and its side covers follow one turn (vinyl.ts publishes data-turn). Next, then a card rebuild (Max → Midi → Max), then Previous; then Previous again and Next (a run of Previous presses once made the next Next turn back): the turn must read back, and no frame may show a side cover with the same picture as the leaving cover while it is still visible (a doubled slot; the arriving cover sitting over the slot it leaves is the hand-off, not a double). A rAF sampler counts those frames. On the running dev app; ends on the starting song, paused.
pass: The shot is ok: every probe expect holds (the turn reads fwd, then back after a Max → Midi → Max rebuild, then fwd after two Backs; doubled 0 on every turn; one cover layer, no receiving mark, no word copy at the end; back on the starting song, paused).

shots.about: Metal turn direction and one layer per slot

steps.eval: (window.__mtRun = () => { const f = window.__mtF = []; (function loop() { const box = document.querySelector('.np__art'); if (!box) return; const shown = [...box.querySelectorAll('.vinyl--out')].filter((v) => +getComputedStyle(v).opacity > 0.05).map((v) => v.querySelector('img')?.src).filter(Boolean); let dbl = 0; box.querySelectorAll('.metal-peek').forEach((p) => { const cs = getComputedStyle(p); if (cs.visibility !== 'hidden' && +cs.opacity > 0.05 && p.dataset.src && shown.includes(p.dataset.src)) dbl++; }); f.push({ dbl, layers: shown.length }); if (f.length < 300) requestAnimationFrame(loop); })(); }, window.__mtRun(), 'ok')

steps.probe: JSON.stringify({turn: document.querySelector('.np__art').dataset.turn, doubled: window.__mtF.filter((x) => x.dbl).length, maxLayers: Math.max(...window.__mtF.map((x) => x.layers))})
steps.name: after-next

steps.probe: (() => { return JSON.stringify({title: document.querySelector('.np__title')?.textContent, turn: document.querySelector('.np__art').dataset.turn, doubled: window.__mtF.filter((x) => x.dbl).length, layers: document.querySelectorAll('.np__art .vinyl').length, receiving: document.querySelectorAll('.metal-peek[data-receiving]').length, ghosts: document.querySelectorAll('[data-metal-ghost]').length}); })()
steps.name: after-back

steps.probe: (async () => { const m = window.MusicKit && MusicKit.getInstance(); if (m && m.isPlaying) { document.querySelector('[data-slot="np"] .np__btn--play').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1200)); } return JSON.stringify({title: document.querySelector('.np__title')?.textContent, turn: document.querySelector('.np__art').dataset.turn, doubled: window.__mtF.filter((x) => x.dbl).length, playing: !!(m && m.isPlaying)}); })()
